name: King Crimson

whyMatters.en: Robert Fripp–centered progressive band whose radical lineup versions—from In the Court (1969) to 1980s dual-guitar—treat reformation as method.
whyMatters.zh: 以 Robert Fripp 为中心的 progressive 乐队：从 In the Court（1969）到 1980 年代双吉他，把彻底重组当作方法。

note.en: Distorted assault opener on 1969 prog debut.
note.zh: 1969 prog 首专上的失真突击开场。

interviewQuotes.text: King Crimson is a way of doing things.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Fripp

interviewQuotes.text: Discipline is a vehicle for music.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Fripp

lyricQuotes: Cat's foot iron claw, neurosurgeons scream for more
Nothing at the end of the rainbow

shortBio.en: Fripp prog laboratory; Schizoid Man and Starless bookend early extremes.
shortBio.zh: Fripp 的 prog 实验室；Schizoid Man 与 Starless 标记早期两极。

body.en:
Formed 1968. Debut In the Court of the Crimson King sets Mellotron + dissonant rock; 1970s Wetton/Bruford years add improvisation and Starless-length pieces; 1981 Belew/Levin/Bruford era uses gamelan-like guitar interlocking (Elephant Talk).

Lineup churn is the point: Fripp remains; casts change.
body.zh:
1968 年组建。首专 In the Court of the Crimson King 定下 Mellotron + 不协和摇滚；1970 年代 Wetton/Bruford 年加入即兴与 Starless 级时长；1981 Belew/Levin/Bruford 时期使用类甘美兰吉他交织（Elephant Talk）。

阵容更替即要点：Fripp 留下；人马更换。

body.en:
Crimson matter because the band is a practice: Fripp keeps the name and standards while replacing instrumental casts.

Opposite of Zeppelin’s stable IV—useful contrast in the chronicle.
body.zh:
Crimson 要紧，因为乐队是一种实践：Fripp 保留名称与标准，同时更换乐器人马。

与 Zeppelin 稳定四人相反——编年中有用的对照。

title.zh: Court 时期、70 年代即兴、80 年代交织

body.en:
Each era has distinct grammar—Mellotron symphonic rock, free-ish metal-jazz, then new-wave-adjacent math guitar.

Versions are not footnotes; they are the catalog.
body.zh:
每个时期有不同语法——Mellotron 交响摇滚、偏自由的金属—爵士、然后新浪潮邻近的数学吉他。

版本不是脚注；它们就是目录。

body.en:
Distorted vocal, saxophone, heavy riff—1969 prog that attacks rather than only floats.

Debut statement still cited by metal and math-rock listeners.
body.zh:
失真人声、萨克斯、重 riff——1969 年进攻而非只漂浮的 prog。

首专声明仍被金属与 math-rock 听众引用。

body.en:
Guitar/composition hub stays; bass, drums, vocal, reeds change across decades.

Read the members list as a version picker.
body.zh:
吉他/作曲枢纽留下；贝斯、鼓、人声、簧乐跨年代更换。

把成员列表当版本选择器阅读。

title.zh: 狂野唱片旁的纪律话语

body.en:
Fripp’s public language about practice and craft matches a catalog that rewards attentive listening.

Method discourse is part of the band’s archival object.
body.zh:
Fripp 关于练习与工艺的公开语言，与一份奖励专注聆听的目录匹配。

方法话语是乐队档案对象的一部分。

title.zh: 给后来变异者的 prog 许可

body.en:
Tool, math rock, and experimental metal cite the permission to change meters and lineups.

Crimson’s lesson is procedural as much as sonic.
body.zh:
Tool、math rock 与实验金属引用其更换拍号与阵容的许可。

Crimson 的课在程序上与声音上同等重要。

note.en: Court of the Crimson King–era Mellotron lineup.
note.zh: Court of the Crimson King 时期 Mellotron 阵容。
Schizoid 突击作为首专引用。

note.en: Lineup reformation as prog working method.
note.zh: 阵容重组作为 prog 工作方法。
